value.rationale: The exact worst inverse list size is a natural invariant of an established NP-complete reconstruction problem. The 30-to-12 fall and 24 rebound across n=8,9,10 expose nonmonotone finite behavior, while the uniquely maximizing n=8 record and its eight orbits give a complete natural extremal classification rather than a single arbitrary input example.
